moqui.agent.AgentToolExposure.title: Report catalog
moqui.agent.AgentToolExposure.description: find#Reports: the catalog reports the user may read, each with its owner app, business purpose, date or status basis, formats and route; narrow by ownerApp, purpose or text. No report runs and no figure is returned.

moqui.agent.AgentToolExposure.title: What a measure means
moqui.agent.AgentToolExposure.description: get#Metric: a registered business measure's meaning (owner, version, grain, basis, aggregation, numerator and denominator, unit policy, dimensions, exclusions, scope, freshness and comparison rules), by metricId, or by the definitionId and panelId of a dashboard panel that names it. A panel without a registered measure answers available false. No figure is returned.

moqui.agent.AgentToolExposure.title: Datasets to ask
moqui.agent.AgentToolExposure.description: find#QuerySources: the admitted business datasets the user reads that insights_query can ask, each with its title, domain owner and whether it holds costs; with a datasetId, its measureFields, groupFields and filterFields, the aggregates and the time grains. Cost and margin datasets and fields are listed only for a user who may see costs.

moqui.agent.AgentToolExposure.title: Ask a business number
moqui.agent.AgentToolExposure.description: run#DatasetQuery: one aggregate over an admitted business dataset from typed choices: datasetId, aggregate (count, sum, avg, min, max, cardinality), measureField, groupBy, groupBy2, timeGrain (day, week, month, quarter, year), filterField with filterValue, from and thru (relative such as now-30d, now-1M/M, now/M, or ISO dates; the last 30 days when empty) and organizationPartyId for one of the user's organizations. It runs as the user with the dataset's row filter and guards, as a dashboard does. Group an amount by its currency field. A refusal (available false with refusedCode and reason) is the answer.

moqui.agent.AgentToolExposure.title: Read a dashboard panel
moqui.agent.AgentToolExposure.description: run#PanelQuery: a saved panel's own numbers as its dashboard shows them to the user, by the dashboard's definitionId and the panel's panelId (or a library panel's definitionId), with from and thru (relative such as now-30d, now-1M/M, now/M, or ISO dates; the last 30 days when empty) and organizationPartyId for one of the user's organizations. Use it for a number that is on a dashboard: it runs the panel's saved query, filters and exclusions, and answers its rows, the count of source records and the measure's registered meaning. No record is returned.

moqui.agent.AgentToolExposure.title: Read a business operations panel
moqui.agent.AgentToolExposure.description: run#OperationsPanel: a saved panel's own numbers as its dashboard shows them to the user, by the dashboard's definitionId and the panel's panelId (or a library panel's definitionId), with from, thru and organizationPartyId for one of the user's organizations. A panel that reads cost, margin, People or payroll data in any of its queries is refused, whatever the user holds.

moqui.agent.AgentToolExposure.title: Business operations datasets
moqui.agent.AgentToolExposure.description: find#OperationsSources: the admitted business operations datasets the user reads that insights_operations_query can ask and, with a datasetId, its measureFields, groupFields and filterFields. Cost, margin, People and payroll data are never listed.

moqui.agent.AgentToolExposure.title: Ask a business operations number
moqui.agent.AgentToolExposure.description: run#OperationsQuery: one aggregate over an admitted business operations dataset from typed choices: datasetId, aggregate (count, sum, avg, min, max, cardinality), measureField, groupBy, groupBy2, timeGrain, filterField with filterValue, from and thru, and organizationPartyId for one of the user's organizations. It runs as the user with the dataset's row filter and guards. Cost, margin, People and payroll datasets and fields are refused (DATASET_RESTRICTED, FIELD_RESTRICTED) whatever the user holds.

moqui.agent.AgentToolExposure.title: My payslip
moqui.agent.AgentToolExposure.description: get#MyPayslip: the signed-in user's own issued payslip (never anyone else's, never a preview or one not issued): payslipId's, else the latest. Its employer, period and pay date, each line the payslip shows with its amount, group and how it was worked out (the formula and values, proration, adjustments, rounding), the totals (gross, deductions, the localization's items, net, employer cost), the year to date, the corrections of it that are issued with the net effect, and the inputs it paid (hours, leave, pieces, claims). With a legacyKey from My payslips, the user's own historical pay record as it was recorded.
